operations.description: Add one temporary-safe PrintString probe node to the dedicated test fixture.

t3d:
Begin Object Class=/Script/BlueprintGraph.K2Node_CallFunction Name="Probe"
   FunctionReference=(MemberParent=Class'"/Script/Engine.KismetSystemLibrary"',MemberName="PrintString")
   NodePosX=0
   NodePosY=0
   NodeGuid={{GUID:probe}}
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:probein}},PinName="execute",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="exec",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:probeout}},PinName="then",Direction="EGPD_Output",PinType.PinCategory="exec",PinType.PinSubCategoryObject=None,)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:probestr}},PinName="InString",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="string",PinType.PinSubCategory="",DefaultValue="{{message}}",)
   CustomProperties Pin (PinId={{GUID:probedur}},PinName="Duration",Direction="EGPD_Input",PinType.PinCategory="real",PinType.PinSubCategory="float",DefaultValue={{duration}},)
End Object
